title: Geographic disparities in registered clinical trials of anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies for migraine: data and analysis code
description: Registry-derived dataset (108 eligible trials; 453 country–trial participations across the 194 WHO Member States), analysis code, figures and supplementary tables for the systematic review of the geographic distribution of registered anti-CGRP monoclonal antibody trials for migraine relative to migraine burden. Code is released under the MIT Licence; data, results, figures and documentation produced by the authors under CC BY 4.0. Third-party inputs (IHME GBD, World Bank, UNDP, UNESCO) are not redistributed; see DATA_ACCESS.md and LICENSES.md.
